headline: Banco de Bogotá Third-Quarter Profit Drops 39% Following Itaú Integration
summary: Colombia's third-largest bank reported a 39% decline in third-quarter profit as it integrated Itaú's retail banking operations.
why: Banco de Bogotá is a premier commercial banking institution in Colombia.

impacts.name: Banco de Bogota
impacts.why: The bank reported a 39% fall in quarterly earnings due to retail business integration costs.
